Let me write the formula. G4 = 1 if F4="Yes" else 0. G5 = G4+1 if F5="Yes" else 0. And so on.

tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && cat > write.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sub CO\'s']
ws['G4'] = '=IF(F4="Yes",1,0)'
ws['G5'] = '=IF(F5="Yes",G4+1,0)'
ws['G6'] = '=IF(F6="Yes",G5+1,0)'
ws['G7'] = '=IF(F7="Yes",G6+1,0)'
ws['G8'] = '=IF(F8="Yes",G7+1,0)'
ws['G9'] = '=IF(F9="Yes",G8+1,0)'
ws['G10'] = '=IF(F10="Yes",G9+1,0)'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print("done")
EOF
